candidate.rationale: Restore controlled archive-slice-bounds behavior: reject interior surrogate-pair starts and move interior ends backward before the pair, rejecting nonempty reads that cannot make progress, per evidence/cases.json requirements.

Replace stringified-JSON comparison with isDeepStrictEqual so parsed JSON is compared structurally (member order insignificant; array order, types, and member presence significant), while preserving response_not_text and invalid_json reasons and the export.

Repair controlled retention-tool-pairs mutation: require call IDs to be unique within each exchange and each tool result to match the assistant call at the same positional index (membership via includes was insufficient per cases-13/14/15), while preserving valid ordered pairing, the recent tail, and masking behavior.

Fix empty-history failure: the retention-window check rejected a valid empty history with recentCount > 0. Allow any non-negative recentCount when history is empty, while keeping uniqueness and exact positional pairing of tool-call IDs vs tool results (fixing pair-0/pair-4 duplicate IDs and pair-1/pair-5 swapped order, plus foreign-id mismatch), preserving all other behavior.

Repair controlled retention-long-window mutation: enforce unique nonempty call IDs per exchange and positional one-to-one tool-result pairing (result ID must equal the assistant call at the same index), replacing the insufficient membership check, per inspected requirements and case interpretations. Export and masking behavior unchanged.

Enforce one-to-one positional pairing: require unique call IDs and that each tool result's tool_call_id equals the assistant call at the same index, instead of membership only; masking and other behavior unchanged.

Fix exact-json-scoring: compare parsed values structurally with isDeepStrictEqual (order-insensitive object members, type/extra/missing members significant) instead of JSON.stringify string comparison; keep response_not_text and invalid_json reasons and exports unchanged.

Repair archive-slice-bounds mutation: reject an interior offset that would split a surrogate pair, and move an interior end backward before splitting a pair, while rejecting a nonempty read that cannot make progress without splitting. Preserves exports, validation, and return fields. No tests were run.

Failed check start-boundary: the offset itself may fall inside a surrogate pair (e.g. offset=3 in "xy😀z" starts at a low surrogate). Add a validation that rejects an offset splitting a pair, in addition to the existing end-boundary backward adjustment and no-progress rejection. Public checks: ("xy😀z",0,3) now yields utf8 "xy" with next_offset 2; ("xy😀z",3,2) and ("😀",0,1) throw inspection-range-splits-unicode.

Restore structural JSON equality using isDeepStrictEqual, which ignores object key order while preserving array order, value types, and missing/extra members. Keeps response_not_text and invalid_json reasons and the existing export unchanged.

Fix retention-tool-pairs validation: require call IDs to be unique within each exchange and require each tool result's tool_call_id to match the assistant call at the same positional index (not mere membership), per evidence/cases.json requirements and examples.
